comments.body: I dont think swiss german people are nicer or worse than the french speaking side it really depends on the circle of people you surround yourself with. In my opinion I think it’s better if you stay in lausanne with french because learning french is difficult yes BUT it’s much easier than german. I came here when I was 13 and had to learn french and it’s normal that people are cold (especially architects 💀)  the same thing happened to me. So yeah Lausanne is much less intimidating than zurich. And for the french what helped me the most was reading and  listening to french songs for the slang. So yeah I hope it will get better for u  ✌🏻✌🏻
comments.author: Designer-Freedom-922
